title: E-Commerce Product Research & Margin Analysis Matrix
summary: Standardized comparison workbook evaluating candidate products across Amazon and Shopify with formula-driven platform fee modeling and 100-point opportunity scoring.
problem: E-commerce store operators waste hours manually evaluating candidate products across disparate marketplaces without a standardized method to calculate true net margins after referral and fulfillment fees.
whatIDid: Built a standardized comparison table tracking marketplace channel, product category, retail price, estimated supplier cost, platform fee rates, rating, and review counts.
Engineered dynamic formula calculations for platform referral fees (=Price * Fee Rate) and true estimated gross margins (=Price - Cost - Fee).
Developed an illustrative 100-point opportunity scoring formula weighting rating reliability against gross margin percentage (=ROUND((Rating/5)*60 + MIN(MAX(Margin/Price,0),0.6)*40, 0)).
Added executive KPI summary blocks, freeze-paned column headers, and structured research notes highlighting verification items before capital allocation.
result: Standardized the candidate evaluation process into a single structured workbook, instantly eliminating manual margin math and ranking viable products by profit potential.
